notes.title: Patch Note V0.4.2.0
notes.content:
Changes 

 
 Added a cooldown to avoid sorcerer to spam grab/release animation with downed villagers 
 Added new progress bar to Exit Doors 
 Added missing mouse sensitivity settings 
 Change the interaction system with the Holy Book and the Book Protection Totems to convert them to the same system as other interactions in the game 
 Added first version of a Tutorial in Main Menu accessible with “How to Play” button 
 

Fixes 

 
 Multiple destroyed Ritual Totems were counted if multiple players destroyed the same totem 
 Progress Bar wasn’t disappearing in some cases when Ritual Totems were destroyed 
 Prevent script of the Exit Doors from not replicating correctly in some cases 
 Prevent villagers to be stuck in final Banish Animation early by adding some additional verification 
 Visual glitches on some VFX have been located and removed 
 

Known issues 

 
 In some cases, players joining a lobby may experience display issues with their XP level, profile picture, and favorite character shown in the lobby. Fix coming soon. 
 

Update size : 44.4 MB

notes.title: Patch Note V0.4.1.2
notes.content:
Changes


 Added new progress bar for Rituals Totems and for Memorials of the Damned


Fixes


 A bug that could create a duplicate of a player character upon players appearance at the beginning of a game
 The possibility for the sorcerer to smash while the player was stunned or in the final banish ritual
 Villagers were never considered to have exited the interaction zone of the exit door
 More than one villagers could trigger the exiting door unlock or prayers on Memorials of the Damned at the same time in some cases
 Incorrect Rituals Totems count was considered for accomplish the Escape quest of the villagers
 Rituals Totems was stopping from being destroyed when a villager leaved the interaction while one or more villagers was still trying to destroying it in some cases
 For some players, the magic circle indicating that they were trying to destroy Ritual Totems wasn’t appearing correctly
 Fix FSR Quality Modes not displaying when graphic card not compatible with DLSS
 Stamina wasn’t decreasing for some players resulting in infinite sprint capability (might still occur, please let us know if you observe it.)


Update size : 30.9 MB

notes.title: Sorrowful Night is now available on Steam !
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce that Sorrowful Night, our new asymmetrical multiplayer game, is now available on Steam. We are excited for our game to be in the hands of players and look forward to seeing them explore its dark and mysterious world.

About Butterfly Effect - Games Studio

Butterfly Effect - Games Studio is a passionate team based in France. We are currently a small team of two people, but we have big plans for the future of our studio. We are determined to provide quality content for our players and hope to soon recruit to strengthen our team.

Current Early Access game content

Sorrowful Night is currently in Early Access, and we are offering the first version of several key features:


 Matchmaking: You can join public matches or create private matches with your friends.
 XP System: You can earn XP by completing matches, which allows you to unlock in-game items.
 Villagers: 6 characters are available, with 2 unlockable through XP.
 Sorcerers: 2 characters with unique skills are available, with 1 unlockable through XP.
 Map: One map is currently available to play.


Why an Epic Games account is necessary

The game was designed from the beginning of its development to allow cross-play and cross-progression. As soon as the game is available on the Epic Games Store and on consoles, when these versions are ready, you will be able to access your save and your friends list, no matter which platform you connect to. That is why we need a common account, and we have chosen an Epic Games account that works with the Epic Online Services to offer this feature.

Upcoming improvements in development

We are currently working on several improvements for Sorrowful Night:


 Matchmaking improvement: We plan to add a feature to indicate that you want to play as a sorcerer prioritized.
 Gameplay improvement: We want to make matches more comfortable for players.
 Dedicated servers: We plan to switch from peer-to-peer to dedicated servers to improve game stability and performance.
 Support for ultra-wide resolutions: We want to support 21:9 and 32:9 resolutions to provide a better gaming experience for players with an ultra-wide monitor.


System Requirements

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43859008/e9e21fab8fee533ec3df12990ebaaef0c9e5a9fb.jpg

Optimization tips

We have done our best to optimize the game, but due to our small team, there may be performance issues for some players. If you experience low FPS, we recommend switching shadows to low to improve performance. We have also integrated Nvidia DLSS and AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 2.2 technologies to help improve performance.

Plans for the future of Sorrowful Night

We have many plans for the future of Sorrowful Night:


 Written/Voice chat system: We plan to add a chat system to facilitate communication between players.
 Villager skills: We plan to give each character their own skill to help players face the challenges of the game.
 Regular content additions: We plan to regularly add content to the game with new rewards, maps, and of course new villagers and sorcerers.
 Competitive matchmaking: We are also looking to integrate a competitive matchmaking system so that you can measure your level and be matched with players of a similar skill level.


Current priority

We want to prioritize optimization and bug fixes, as being a small team, our internal testing capabilities are limited, and that's why we need your help to locate and eradicate potential bugs in Sorrowful Night. We will also take all feedback into consideration regarding improvement suggestions for the game, whether it be modification or even adding new content that we may not have thought of without you. To report any issues, we have set up a Discord server, but we will also be paying close attention to Steam discussions.
